Why they stay cold

This is not a winter problem. Losing the insulating layer makes people cold in August, at a desk, in air conditioning.

Google explains it, unprompted

The causeThe body loses its insulating layer of subcutaneous fat and the metabolism adjusts
Why woolFibre crimp creates air pockets that replace the missing insulation
Versus syntheticWool holds up to 30% of its weight in moisture without feeling wet; synthetics trap sweat and turn cold on the skin
The clincherA wool scarf or beanie bought today fits the same after another 10 or 20 kilograms — Google calls it a stable investment

Two slots, one wedge

One of these is hard to win and one is close to open. They are not the same opportunity and should not be worked in the same order.

Base layers — the hard one

Their productOG base layer, 100% merino, no elastane
The problemNothing they publish answers the size-change question, so the criterion rules them out before warmth is considered
Fixable byWords, not product

Accessories — the wedge

Why it winsNo sizing decision, no fit returns — and their own reviews show sizing is where customers get stuck
Google alreadyRecommends merino for this by name, and explains why
WhitespaceWool body warmers — the only row where Google could not name a real brand

Icebreaker and Smartwool hold the accessory slots today. They win on published content, not on better wool — which is the part that can change.

What this does not prove

The boundary matters more than the findings. Everything here is softer than it looks, and you should know which parts.

Single runs

Each query was run once. Engine answers move between sessions and users.

The two markets disagreed

New Zealand answered merino. The United States did not. Both are in this document.

No search volume

There is no keyword tool in this stack. The seasonal read is reasoning, not measurement.

Nobody has measured conversion

How many of these people buy wool is unknown. That is why you set those two sliders, not us.

The wedge is not vacant

Icebreaker and Smartwool hold the accessory slots. They win on published content, not better wool.

No guaranteed mention

Nobody can promise a named slot in an AI answer. The work makes a brand readable and citable.

We have no sourced figure for European GLP-1 uptake. Europe appears here as a sequencing note only, with no market size attached.

What we would need to talk about

Stock levels and production capability first — being the answer is worse than useless if you run out in their December.

Two winters, one build

Your season is May to August. America and Europe both peak November to February, in the months your own market goes quiet.

Ranges for a market that changes size

Accessories, body warmers and extended sizing are the lines this buyer asks for. That is a conversation, not a slide.

The question is being asked today, and the answer is already merino. The only thing still open is whose name is on it.

We have done this for six New Zealand businesses. Francis and Lucy, we would rather show you than tell you.
